android._comment: Update nudge ACTIVE on both platforms. iOS 1.6 (build 10) live on the App Store (released Sep 9 2026); Android 1.6 (vc7) live on Play Store Production since Sep 7 2026 (Active, vc6 now Inactive) — older builds are prompted to update (bitmap sticker printing). Note: Android users on vc5 or older have no getBuildNumber bridge (readBinaryBuild returns Infinity), so they are never prompted — expected, not a bug.
